rules.overlap: Normalized trace of equal-rank support projectors; saved best-found alignments, not certified maxima.
rules.rotation: For each input: occupation-basis conjugation, then plotting-convention Euler angles in radians. Null means identity. Plotting/viewing rotations are separately stored in the plotting scripts.
rules.paths: All active file and script paths are relative to the release root. Scientific modules and group data are bundled under code/.
